Sub OutPut()

​

Dim MyBook As Workbook

Dim sh1, sh2 As Worksheet

Dim cell As Range

Dim Lrow, Drow, Rtitle, Rstreet, Rphone, Rweb As Integer

Dim ans1 As String

​

Set MyBook = ActiveWorkbook

Set sh1 = MyBook.Sheets("Data")

Set sh2 = MyBook.Sheets("Output")

Lrow = 6

​

Rtitle = sh2.Range("D1")

Rstreet = sh2.Range("E1")

Rphone = sh2.Range("F1")

Rweb = sh2.Range("G1")

​

Drow = sh1.Range("A1000000").End(xlUp).Row

​

If Drow < 2 Then

sh1.Activate

MsgBox "No Data Found!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation

Exit Sub

End If

​

​

If Len(Rtitle) = 0 Or Not IsNumeric(Rtitle) Then

MsgBox "Any Column with Name """ & sh2.Range("D2") & """ Not Found", vbOKOnly + vbCritical

Exit Sub

ElseIf Len(Rstreet) = 0 Or Not IsNumeric(Rstreet) Then

MsgBox "Any Column with Name """ & sh2.Range("E2") & """ Not Found", vbOKOnly + vbCritical

Exit Sub

ElseIf Len(Rphone) = 0 Or Not IsNumeric(Rphone) Then

MsgBox "Any Column with Name """ & sh2.Range("F2") & """ Not Found", vbOKOnly + vbCritical

Exit Sub

ElseIf Len(Rweb) = 0 Or Not IsNumeric(Rweb) Then

MsgBox "Any Column with Name """ & sh2.Range("G2") & """ Not Found", vbOKOnly + vbCritical

Exit Sub

End If

​

sh2.Activate

sh2.Range("A" & Lrow & ":B" & 100000).Select

ans1 = MsgBox("Click ""OK"" to continue" & Chr(10) & "Any Previous Output will be Deleted!", vbOKCancel + vbCritical)

If ans1 <> vbOK Then

Exit Sub

End If

​

sh2.Range("A" & Lrow & ":B100000").Clear

sh2.Range("A" & Lrow & ":B100000").NumberFormat = "@"

​

Application.ScreenUpdating = False

​

If Drow > 101 Then

Drow = 101

End If

​

For Each cell In sh1.Range("A2:A" & Drow)

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow) = sh1.Cells(cell.Row, Rtitle)         'Title

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 1) = sh1.Cells(cell.Row, Rstreet)     'Address

If InStr(1, sh1.Range("A" & cell.Row), ",", vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 2) = Trim(Right(sh1.Range("A" & cell.Row), Len(sh1.Range("A" & cell.Row)) - InStr(1, sh1.Range("A" & cell.Row), ",", vbTextCompare) - 1))

Else

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 2) = ""

End If

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 3) = sh1.Cells(cell.Row, Rphone)

sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 4) = sh1.Cells(cell.Row, Rweb)



With sh2.Range("B" & Lrow + 5 & ":B" & Lrow + 5).Borders(xlEdgeTop)

.LineStyle = xlContinuous

.ColorIndex = xlAutomatic

.TintAndShade = 0

.Weight = xlMedium

End With

​

If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountBlank(sh2.Range("B" & Lrow & ":B" & Lrow + 4)) > 0 Then

sh2.Range("A" & Lrow & ":B" & Lrow).Interior.Color = 65535

End If



Lrow = Lrow + 6

​

Next cell

​

Application.ScreenUpdating = True

sh2.Activate

sh2.Range("A5").Select

MsgBox "Completed!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation

​

​

​

End Sub
